question: In Episode 72, Rickert-san in the past appeared to be wearing knight's clothing. He is currently a civil official, but was he originally a member of the Royal Guard?
answer:
He retired after losing to Reinhard. So that scene in Episode 72, where he loses to Reinhard, is his retirement scene. The sequence is that he puts down his sword, saying, “It seems I'm getting old,” and becomes a civil official. So it's another case of, “Looks like Reinhard has made someone retire again...” (laughs).

Rickert-san is the father of Rachins, the eccentric member of the Felt camp, and he also taught the younger Crusch-san and Julius how to use a sword. I've actually created quite a few little bits of setting for him, so he's a character I like, and I work him in whenever there's an opportunity.

Every time he appears, though, something a little unfortunate seems to happen to him. (laughs) The fact that Rachins, the son of the man Reinhard made retire, is now in the same faction as Reinhard and working alongside him as a comrade is somehow rather suggestive in a good way.
